description: This file defines a test adapter class for Zend Framework's HTTP client, used for testing purposes by simulating HTTP responses without making real network requests.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Test
classes.description: A testing adapter for Zend HTTP client that simulates HTTP responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: setNextRequestWillFail
methods.description: Sets a flag to make the next request fail with an exception.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options for the adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Simulates connecting to a remote server, can be set to fail.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Builds and returns a string representation of an HTTP request.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Returns the next response in the response buffer.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Dummy method to close the connection.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response(s) to be returned by the read() method.

methods.name: addResponse
methods.description: Adds an additional response to the response buffer.

methods.name: setResponseIndex
methods.description: Sets which response will be returned on the next call to read().
